QueryString.value: WITH calendars AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, IterationPath, coalesce(Team, '') AS Team, coalesce(Sprint, '') AS Sprint, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Start)) / 1000 AS Start, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Finish)) / 1000 AS Finish FROM ADOTelemetry_Sprint FINAL ), flow AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toString(PullRequestId) AS PullRequestId, toString(WorkItemId) AS WorkItemId, coalesce(State, '') AS State, coalesce(IterationPath, '') AS IterationPath, coalesce(Team, '') AS Team, coalesce(TargetBranch, '') AS TargetBranch, coalesce(TargetPackageVersion, '') AS TargetPackageVersion, coalesce(InitialIterationPath, '') AS InitialIterationPath, toFloat64(HistoryAvailable) AS HistoryAvailable, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(PullRequestCreated)) / 1000 AS Created, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(PullRequestMerged)) / 1000 AS Merged FROM ADOTelemetry_WorkItemFlow FINAL ), runs AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toString(BuildId) AS BuildId, coalesce(Pipeline, '') AS Pipeline, coalesce(Environment, '') AS Environment, coalesce(TargetBranch, '') AS TargetBranch, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Result, '') AS Result, coalesce(ReleaseOutcome, '') AS ReleaseOutcome, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Started)) / 1000 AS Started, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Finished)) / 1000 AS Finished FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineRun FINAL WHERE Role = 'CD' ), failures AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toString(BuildId) AS BuildId, toString(TestRunId) AS TestRunId, TestName AS Resource, coalesce(Pipeline, '') AS Pipeline, coalesce(Environment, '') AS Environment, coalesce(Outcome, '') AS Outcome, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(FailingUntil)) / 1000 AS Finished FROM ADOTelemetry_TestFailure FINAL WHERE (Organization, Project, toString(BuildId)) IN (SELECT Organization, Project, toString(BuildId) FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineRun FINAL WHERE Role = 'CD') ), stages AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, coalesce(Repository, '') AS Repository, toString(BuildId) AS BuildId, coalesce(StepName, '') AS Step, coalesce(Result, '') AS Result, toFloat64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Finished)) / 1000 AS Finished FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineStep FINAL WHERE RecordType = 'Stage' AND IsApprovalStage = 1 AND (Organization, Project, toString(BuildId)) IN (SELECT Organization, Project, toString(BuildId) FROM ADOTelemetry_PipelineRun FINAL WHERE Role = 'CD') ), windows AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, Team, Sprint, IterationPath, Start, Finish, leadInFrame(Start, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY Organization, Project, Team ORDER BY Start, IterationPath ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS NextSprintStart FROM calendars WHERE Start IS NOT NULL AND Finish IS NOT NULL AND Team != '' ), approvals AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, Repository, BuildId, max(Finished) AS RetainedAt FROM stages WHERE Result IN ('succeeded', 'succeededWithIssues') AND Finished IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Organization, Project, Repository, BuildId ), events AS ( SELECT Organization, Project, Repository, Team, 'CreatedPR' AS Kind, 'PRs created' AS Series, PullRequestId AS RecordId, '' AS Environment, TargetBranch, TargetPackageVersion AS PackageVersion, 'LatestWorkItemTarget' AS VersionSource, State, '' AS ReleaseOutcome, Created AS EventTime, Created AS EndTime, toFloat64(0) AS RetentionTimeApproximate, WorkItemId AS WorkItemId FROM flow WHERE Created IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT Organization, Project, Repository, Team, 'MergedPR', 'PRs merged', PullRequestId, '', TargetBranch, TargetPackageVersion, 'LatestWorkItemTarget', State, '', Merged, Merged, toFloat64(0), WorkItemId FROM flow WHERE Merged IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT Organization, Project, Repository, '', 'TestFailure', 'Test failures', concat(BuildId, ':', TestRunId, ':', Resource), Environment, '', '', 'Unavailable', Outcome, '', Finished, Finished, toFloat64(0), '' FROM failures WHERE Finished IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT Organization, Project, Repository, '', 'CDRun', multiIf(Result = 'failed', 'CD failed', Result = 'canceled', 'CD canceled', Result = 'partiallySucceeded', 'CD partial', Result = 'succeeded', 'CD succeeded', 'CD unknown'), BuildId, Environment, TargetBranch, Version, 'CD', Result, ReleaseOutcome, Started, Finished, toFloat64(0), '' FROM runs WHERE Started IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT run.Organization, run.Project, run.Repository, '', 'CDRetained', 'CD approved and retained', run.BuildId, run.Environment, run.TargetBranch, run.Version, 'CD', run.Result, run.ReleaseOutcome, coalesce(approvals.RetainedAt, run.Finished), run.Finished, toFloat64(approvals.RetainedAt IS NULL), '' FROM runs AS run LEFT JOIN approvals ON run.Organization = approvals.Organization AND run.Project = approvals.Project AND run.Repository = approvals.Repository AND run.BuildId = approvals.BuildId WHERE run.ReleaseOutcome IN ('ReleasedClean', 'ReleasedWithFailures') AND coalesce(approvals.RetainedAt, run.Finished) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT windows.Organization AS Organization, windows.Project AS Project, events.Repository AS Repository, windows.Team AS Team, windows.Sprint AS Sprint, windows.IterationPath AS IterationPath, events.Kind AS Kind, events.Series AS Series, events.RecordId AS RecordId, events.Environment AS Environment, events.TargetBranch AS TargetBranch, events.PackageVersion AS PackageVersion, events.VersionSource AS VersionSource, events.State AS State, events.ReleaseOutcome AS ReleaseOutcome, windows.Finish AS ExpectedFinish, windows.NextSprintStart AS NextSprintStart, events.EventTime AS EventTime, events.EndTime AS EndTime, toFloat64(floor((events.EventTime - windows.Finish) / 86400)) AS DaysFromSprintEnd, toFloat64(ifNull(events.EventTime >= windows.NextSprintStart AND events.EventTime < windows.NextSprintStart + 259200, 0)) AS EarlyNextSprint, toFloat64(events.Kind IN ('CDRun', 'CDRetained') AND ifNull(events.PackageVersion, '') = '') AS CDVersionMissing, events.RetentionTimeApproximate AS RetentionTimeApproximate, events.WorkItemId AS WorkItemId, linked.IterationPath AS WorkItemIterationPath, linked.InitialIterationPath AS InitialIterationPath, linked.HistoryAvailable AS HistoryAvailable, multiIf(events.Kind NOT IN ('CreatedPR', 'MergedPR'), 'NotApplicable', linked.IterationPath = windows.IterationPath, 'CurrentAssignment', linked.HistoryAvailable = 1 AND linked.InitialIterationPath = windows.IterationPath, 'RecordedInitialAssignment', 'Unverified') AS SprintLinkEvidence FROM windows INNER JOIN events ON windows.Organization = events.Organization AND windows.Project = events.Project LEFT JOIN flow AS linked ON events.Organization = linked.Organization AND events.Project = linked.Project AND events.Repository = linked.Repository AND events.RecordId = linked.PullRequestId AND events.WorkItemId = linked.WorkItemId AND events.Kind IN ('CreatedPR', 'MergedPR') WHERE (events.Team = windows.Team OR (events.Team = '' AND events.Kind NOT IN ('CreatedPR', 'MergedPR')) OR linked.IterationPath = windows.IterationPath OR (linked.HistoryAvailable = 1 AND linked.InitialIterationPath = windows.IterationPath)) AND events.EventTime >= windows.Finish - 604800 AND events.EventTime < coalesce(windows.NextSprintStart, windows.Finish) + 604800
